_source: tools/postprocess/run.ts `placeholders` wrote every file listed here with tools/postprocess/placeholder.ts's `makePlaceholder`. NONE of them is art. tools/comfy/manifest.json still has all 35 dex-painted rows at status "pending", and this file is what keeps a readout that counts files on disk from contradicting it.
_contract: Every id here names a PNG under this directory whose bytes are exactly what `makePlaceholder(placeholderLabel(path), width, height, {palette})` produces today. tests/gates/stand-in-declaration.test.ts re-derives that set from the pixels and fails if this list is not it — so landing real art at one of these paths reddens the suite until the id is removed, and adding a placeholder without listing it reddens it too. Do not hand-edit this list to make something look built.
_consumer: game/placeholder.ts globs assets/final/**/stand-ins.json at build time and refuses to register these ids as real art: hasRealAsset() answers false, the boot loader never queues them, and the game goes on drawing its own slot-sized labelled stand-in — which stays legible where a 1024² offline placeholder squeezed into a 128² dex slot does not.
